Truesilver Bracelet (Reprisal): On casting your Ultimate: Gain a 100 (+18%) Shield for 4s.• While the Shield holds you are CC Immune.• When removed, it explodes dealing Damage equal to 40% of the initial Shield.
Narbash dealt 12,344 hero damage, 7% of their team's, with +125 magical power from items.

Truesilver Bracelet (item): On casting your Ultimate: Gain a 100 (+18%) Shield for 4s. While the Shield holds you are CC Immune. When removed, it explodes dealing Damage equal to 40% of the initial Shield.
Everbloom (item): On Healing or Shielding an Ally: Grant them 5% Damage Mitigation and 20 Tenacity for 2s.
Tainted Totem (item): On dealing damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
Exarch (Eternal): Healing or Shielding a target (including yourself) grants them 10% Total Attack Speed and empowers their Basic Attacks to deal 10% bonus Magical Damage On-Hit for 4s.

Sustain: 20% heal and shield power; Truesilver Bracelet: On casting your Ultimate: Gain a 100 (+18%) Shield for 4s. While the Shield holds you are CC Immune. When removed, it explodes dealing Damage equal to 40% of the initial Shield.; Everbloom: On Healing or Shielding an Ally: Grant them 5% Damage Mitigation and 20 Tenacity for 2s.; Tainted Totem: On Healing and Shielding Allies: Grant them Blighted Touch for 4s.; Xenia: When within 200u to an Ally Hero: Grant them a 50 (+10%)(+5 per Level) Shield for 4s. Cooldown is per Target.; Sanctification: Grants yourself and nearby Heroes a 150 (+8%) Shield for 3s. While the Shield holds, Heroes gain 50% Tenacity.; Preservation: Healing or shielding you receive is increased by 10%.; 32,504 healing recorded.
Toughness: +920 health, +65 physical armor, +60 magical armor, +25% tenacity; took 40,650 damage, mitigated 44,118, died 3 times.

Loadout augment Percussive Tear: Every hit of Crash Bang Boom! lowers enemy armors briefly. Your team deals more damage to everyone caught in the drum solo. (game text: Each hit of Crash Bang Boom! Shreds 2.5% Armors for 3s.) (changes Crash Bang Boom!, 65.4s cooldown with their haste) Field: 52.1% in 4499 games, 69% of picks, level the hero-role's 52.9%.

Loadout Eternal Exarch: Healing or shielding a target gives them 10% attack speed and extra magic damage on basic attacks for 4s. Song health regeneration may not count as healing, so pair it with Tranquility or Sanctification. (game text: Healing or Shielding a target (including yourself) grants them 10% Total Attack Speed and empowers their Basic Attacks to deal 10% bonus Magical Damage On-Hit for 4s.) Field: 53.3% in 4907 games, 75% of picks, level the hero-role's 52.9%.

Loadout minor Preservation: Healing and shields you receive are stronger. A defensive pick for a frontline support. (game text: Healing or shielding you receive is increased by 10%.) Field: 53.1% in 4068 games, 83% of picks, level the hero-role's 52.9%.

Loadout minor Omnipresent: Generic: more movement speed when out of combat, for roaming between lanes. (game text: Gain 7% Movement Speed when out of combat.) Field: 51.8% in 2966 games, 60% of picks, below the hero-role's 52.9%.

Loadout crest Sanctification: Shields nearby allies and makes them resist crowd control while it holds. Pop it before the enemy engages or as your team goes in. (game text: Safeguard:  Grants yourself and nearby Heroes a 150 (+8%) Shield for 3s. While the Shield holds, Heroes gain 50% Tenacity. Visionary:  Gain Solstone. Increase Ward Cap from 2 to 3. Pacifist:  Receive diminishing Gold from Minion kills.) Field: 53.5% in 3965 games, 61% of picks, level the hero-role's 52.9%.

Stack (Kept alive in fights): 8 effects on one trigger: Truesilver Bracelet, Everbloom, Vanguardian, Tainted Totem, Xenia, Sanctification, Exarch, Preservation. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 4 effects on one trigger: Everbloom, Tainted Totem, Exarch, Preservation.

The Eternal was part of it: Exarch (Preservation + Omnipresent) sits on the same triggers as the items (kept alive in fights; healing off the damage), so every extra second in a fight made them harder to kill.
Countered? 0 of the 1 players Narbash killed built magical armor. Anti-heal on Feng Mao. We killed Narbash 3 times.
Copy it? Exarch (Preservation + Omnipresent): 51.9% in 2,688 Narbash support games, below the hero's 52.9%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
